note: Anchor-based, idempotent C patches for FAangband, applied by apply_patches.py. Authored by /fa-codepatch. Anchors are literal substrings that must match exactly once.

upstream.subject: On a shapechange, only learn shape's resistances that differ from baseline
upstream.note: NEVER-REGRESS BASELINE. Every anchor below was proven to locate uniquely against THIS upstream commit. apply_patches.py compares the target tree's HEAD against it on every run and, on drift, reports which anchored files upstream touched -- so an at-risk patch group is announced BEFORE anchors are attempted. Advance this pin ONLY via `apply_patches.py <FA_DIR> --repin`, which refuses unless every patch classifies READY/ALREADY against the new HEAD. Each advance appends to `history`, so the baseline can always be walked backwards.

history.note: Initial pin. Established retroactively -- this is the tree the 83 anchors were authored against, all classifying READY/ALREADY at pin time.

patches.payload:
/* HITHER-LANDS:display-default-tile-scale
		 * 64px art in a 10x22 cell: 7x3 cells is 70x66px, near square.
		 * TWO guards:
		 * 1. OUR TILESET ONLY. This runs for whatever mode is being loaded.
		 *    Stock tilesets are 8x8..32x32; 7x3 stretches an 8px tile across
		 *    70x66px and collapses the map to ~11 columns.
		 * 2. FIRST RUN ONLY -- gate on the ABSENCE of the config file, the
		 *    way display-default-tileset does, NOT on tile_width==1. The live
		 *    tile_width is a POISONABLE sentinel: the GRAPHICS_NONE arm above
		 *    and help-tile-scale (ui-help.c) both write 1, so a disable/enable
		 *    graphics cycle read as "no choice" and reset a saved 4x4 to 7x3
		 *    every launch (issue #13 D3; ledger
		 *    INC-2026-07-23-tile-scale-sentinel-poisoned). The frontend writes
		 *    the config on exit, so !file_exists is true exactly once, for a
		 *    genuine first run; after that the player's saved
		 *    window-tile-scale (loaded by read_config_file) always wins.
		 * ASCII keeps 1x1 via the other arm of this if/else. */
		if (!file_exists(g_app.config_file)
				&& (streq(mode->menuname, "Hither Lands")
					|| suffix(mode->path, "fa-ai")
					|| suffix(mode->path, "fa-ai/"))) {
			tile_width = 7;
			tile_height = 3;
		}
patches.note: D3 fix: gate the 7x3 default on config-file absence (true first run), not on the poisonable tile_width==1 live sentinel
